name: length-oversize-reject
meaning: A VALUE with LL=1 whose u32 length is 0xFFFFFFFF, with no payload. The declared length is above MAX_TLV_BYTES (recommended 16 MiB), so the frame is oversize, not short: tr::frame::invalid (RFC-0001 §C.3; RFC-0002; docs/reference/01-data-format.md §Truncation handling). A successful decode of this frame is a conformance FAILURE.
